import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
a,b,p=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
launch=json.loads(a.read_text())
snapshot=json.loads(b.read_text())
cutoff=datetime.fromisoformat(launch['observation_deadline_utc'])
assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)>=cutoff
assert launch['deploy_status']=='ONLINE_VERIFIED' and launch['hash_match']
assert launch['expected_index_sha256']==launch['fetched_sha256']
assert cutoff==datetime.fromisoformat(snapshot['historical_cutoff_utc'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
result={
 'experiment':launch['experiment'],
 'scope':'Original 14-day offer experiment ending at its documented cutoff. This verdict does not adjudicate separately authorized revision-specific windows.',
 'launch_evidence':str(a),
 'deployment_task':launch['deploy_task'],
 'approved_digest':launch['approved_digest'],
 'launch_homepage_sha256':launch['expected_index_sha256'],
 'cutoff_utc':cutoff.isoformat(),
 'feedback_evidence':str(b),
 'feedback':snapshot['feedback'],
 'eligible_requests':None,'completed_replies':None,'explicit_paid_interest':None,'accepted_orders':None,
 'experiment_attributed_verified_settlement_cents':None,
 'treasury_verified_revenue_cents_at_provisional_checkpoint':snapshot['treasury_verified_revenue_cents'],
 'order_register':snapshot['order_register'],
 'decision':'End measurement for the original window as inconclusive. Retain intake under the terms of the live release.',
 'later_homepage_capture':'The later capture has different bytes. It is not used to establish the launch or reset the cutoff.',
 'reconsider_on':'A release-attributed eligible inquiry, attributable coverage repair, or an authoritative record of a separate or superseding window.'
}
p.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
assert json.loads(p.read_text())==result
